NewsArticle.Title: The Sacrifice: Wolf's Bane
NewsArticle.Content: Hesperos's [daughter was kidnapped.](http://www.darkages.com/news/990926_2.html) He now writes: I offer six times the normal value for any parts of a wolf: Wolf's Skin, Wolf's Fur, Wolf's Teeth, Wolf's Lock. I am frantic to find my daughter before the new year's ritual known as Caroun in Undine and Suomi; a time of ritual sacrifice for the year's crops. More evil sects in the kingdom of Suomi have used humans for their sacrifices. You can find me, sober or drunk, in Undine's Tavern, which is along the south road of Undine. Mundanes of Undine have built passage between the North and South roads of Undine to cross the pool. This passage is between the Northern Higgler and the Sothern Tavern of Undine. Hesperos Bard of Undine Caroun of Deoch 7, Spring is traditionally around 99.10.03 4 - 5 p.m. The Sacrifice: 99.10.01 - 99.10.03 The 7th Year of Deoch begins 99.10.01. Undine's movement begins 99.10.01 5 p.m. Ends 99.10.03 7 p.m. Enter Dark Ages, listen to the Events of Temuair and talk to Hesperos in Undine Tavern for details. Read "Wood Goblin Social Structure" in Loures Library Philosophy wing: [www.darkages.com/atavism/phi](http://www.darkages.com/atavism/phi)
